rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when a person or circumstance forces someone to act.

example.english: They compel me to hand in the report today.
example.traditional: 佢逼我今日一定要交份報告。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bik1 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when a fact, event, or situation powerfully prompts a course of action without explicit coercion.

example.english: This situation can compel us to change our plans.
example.traditional: 呢個情況令我哋改變計劃。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 ling6 ngo5 dei6 goi2 bin3 gai3 waak6

rows.jyutping: ling6 jan4 mou4 faat3 kong3 keoi5
rows.note: Use this when something has an irresistible effect, especially an appeal or attraction that cannot be resisted.

example.english: The aroma of this shop’s egg tarts is so irresistible that it can compel anyone to try one.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅蛋撻香味令人無法抗拒。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 daan6 taat1 hoeng1 mei6 ling6 jan4 mou4 faat3 kong3 keoi5
